display_name: HEIDENHAIN TNC 640 CNC control (DNC / LSV-2 / StateMonitor)
source: HEIDENHAIN TNC 640 User's Manual - Setup, Testing and Running NC Programs, NC software 34059x-17, document 1261174-24 (10/2022), sections 3.4 Status displays (pp.69-81), 4 Tool data (p.154), 11.14 Displaying operating times (p.467), 14 Specifications (pp.604-605); HEIDENHAIN StateMonitor product page heidenhain.us/products/digital-shop-floor/statemonitor/. Raw tag spellings for the LSV-2 R_RI channel follow pyLSV2 (github.com/drunsinn/pyLSV2, MIT) const.py ParRRI / PgmState / ExecState and misc.py decode_override_state/decode_tool_info - REVERSE-ENGINEERED THIRD PARTY, not vendor documentation.
vendor_native_note: Two tag families, deliberately kept distinct. `R_RI.*` are the LSV-2 R_RI sub-parameter channels as pyLSV2 names them - third-party reverse engineering, marked as such in mapping_provenance on every row. `STATUS.*` and `TOOL.*` are the status-display and tool-table items the TNC 640 manual names, in the manual's own spelling. HEIDENHAIN's OPC UA NC Server and DNC DCOM interfaces are NOT represented here: no fetchable document lists their node names or method names, and inventing them would be worse than omitting them.

mapping_provenance.MACHINE TIMES.Control on: TNC 640 manual 1261174-24 s11.14 (p.467), MOD area MACHINE TIMES: 'Operating time of the control since being put into service'. NO UNIT IS STATED IN THE MANUAL - `h` is declared here by pack-author judgement, not vendor fact.
mapping_provenance.MACHINE TIMES.Machine on: TNC 640 manual 1261174-24 s11.14 (p.467): 'Operating time of the machine tool since being put into service'. Unit not stated by the vendor; `h` is pack-author judgement.
mapping_provenance.MACHINE TIMES.Program run: TNC 640 manual 1261174-24 s11.14 (p.467): 'Duration of controlled operation since being put into service'. Unit not stated by the vendor; `h` is pack-author judgement. The manual also states the machine tool builder may add further operating-time displays, so this list is not closed.
mapping_provenance.R_RI.CURRENT_TOOL.number: THIRD PARTY, REVERSE ENGINEERED: pyLSV2 const.py ParRRI.CURRENT_TOOL = 51 and misc.py decode_tool_info() ('number' is the leading big-endian !L). pyLSV2 docs/protocol.rst records R_RI 51 as available on iTNC and NOT on TNC - so this row may never produce a reading on a TNC 640.
mapping_provenance.R_RI.EXEC_STATE: THIRD PARTY, REVERSE ENGINEERED: pyLSV2 const.py ParRRI.EXEC_STATE = 23, class ExecState = {0 MANUAL, 1 MDI, 2 PASS_REFERENCES, 3 SINGLE_STEP, 4 AUTOMATIC, 5 UNDEFINED}. The TNC 640 manual's own five machine operating modes (Manual operation, Electronic handwheel, Positioning with Manual Data Input, Program Run Single Block, Program Run Full Sequence) are order-consistent with 0-4 but NEITHER SOURCE ASSERTS THE CORRESPONDENCE - treated here as unconfirmed.
mapping_provenance.R_RI.FIRST_ERROR.e_number: THIRD PARTY, REVERSE ENGINEERED: pyLSV2 const.py ParRRI.FIRST_ERROR = 27 and misc.py decode_error_message() (e_class !H, e_group !H, e_number SIGNED !l, e_text). e_number is signed, so a sign-blind integer cast is wrong. pyLSV2 docs/protocol.rst records R_RI 27/28 as iTNC-only.
mapping_provenance.R_RI.FIRST_ERROR.e_text: THIRD PARTY, REVERSE ENGINEERED: pyLSV2 misc.py decode_error_message() trailing string. Language depends on the control's selected language code.
mapping_provenance.R_RI.OVERRIDE.feed: THIRD PARTY, REVERSE ENGINEERED: pyLSV2 misc.py decode_override_state() - three big-endian !L fields each divided by 100, IN WIRE ORDER feed, spindle, rapid. The display string in dat_cls.py OverrideState.__str__ is ordered feed, rapid, spindle, which is NOT the wire order; mapping by display order swaps spindle and rapid.
mapping_provenance.R_RI.OVERRIDE.rapid: THIRD PARTY, REVERSE ENGINEERED: pyLSV2 misc.py decode_override_state(), THIRD !L on the wire (bytes 8:11), /100. See the wire-vs-display order warning on R_RI.OVERRIDE.feed.
mapping_provenance.R_RI.OVERRIDE.spindle: THIRD PARTY, REVERSE ENGINEERED: pyLSV2 misc.py decode_override_state(), SECOND !L on the wire (bytes 4:7), /100.
mapping_provenance.R_RI.PGM_STATE: THIRD PARTY, REVERSE ENGINEERED: pyLSV2 const.py ParRRI.PGM_STATE = 26 and class PgmState = {0 Started, 1 Stopped, 2 Finished, 3 Cancelled, 4 Interrupted, 5 Error, 6 Error Cleared, 7 Idle, 8 Undefined}. pyLSV2 docs/protocol.rst: reading R_RI 26 requires a DNC login, and 'DNC login is only possible if the option is set on the control' - so this row needs a paid software option enabled on the machine.
mapping_provenance.R_RI.SELECTED_PGM.current: THIRD PARTY, REVERSE ENGINEERED: pyLSV2 const.py ParRRI.SELECTED_PGM = 24 and misc.py decode_stack_info() - NUL-separated `main` then `current` program names after a leading !L line number. Requires a DN login level.
mapping_provenance.R_RI.SELECTED_PGM.line_no: THIRD PARTY, REVERSE ENGINEERED: pyLSV2 misc.py decode_stack_info() leading big-endian !L.
mapping_provenance.R_RI.SELECTED_PGM.main: THIRD PARTY, REVERSE ENGINEERED: pyLSV2 misc.py decode_stack_info() `main` field. Maps to the same canonical as .current deliberately - the main program is the one a shop calls 'the program'.
mapping_provenance.STATUS.F: TNC 640 manual 1261174-24 s3.4 general status display (p.70): 'Feed rate F'. s14 input formats: 0 to 99 999.999 (5,3) [mm/min] or [mm/tooth] or [mm/1]. THE MANUAL ALSO STATES: 'The displayed feed rate in inches corresponds to one tenth of the effective value' - an inch-configured control reports F at 1/10 scale and this pack does not compensate for it.
mapping_provenance.STATUS.S: TNC 640 manual 1261174-24 s3.4 (p.70): 'Spindle speed S'. s14: 0 to 99 999.999 (5,3) [rpm]; hardware maximum 100 000 rpm with 2 pole pairs.
mapping_provenance.STATUS.T: TNC 640 manual 1261174-24 s3.4 (p.70): 'Number of the active tool'. s14 input range 0 to 32 767.9 (5,1).
mapping_provenance.STATUS.X: TNC 640 manual 1261174-24 s3.4 (p.69) machine axes group. Display step as fine as 0.01 um for linear axes (s14, p.604); displayed decimals are set by machine parameter CfgPosDisplayPace (no. 101000), so the number of decimals is machine-configured and not a property of this mapping. Position-display MODE (actual vs nominal) is selected by ACTL, so this row's meaning depends on a control setting this pack cannot read.
mapping_provenance.STATUS.Y: TNC 640 manual 1261174-24 s3.4 (p.69). See STATUS.X for the ACTL and CfgPosDisplayPace caveats.
mapping_provenance.STATUS.Z: TNC 640 manual 1261174-24 s3.4 (p.69). See STATUS.X for the ACTL and CfgPosDisplayPace caveats.
mapping_provenance.STATUS.feed_potentiometer_pct: TNC 640 manual 1261174-24 s3.4 additional status display, spindle/feed monitoring tab (p.81): 'Current factor of the feed-rate potentiometer in %'. The manual states this tab is shown only if the function is active on the machine.
mapping_provenance.STATUS.spindle_load_pct: TNC 640 manual 1261174-24 s3.4 additional status display (p.81): 'Active spindle load in %'. The same tab publishes a 'Reference load of the spindle' baseline, which this pack does not map because no canonical field exists for a per-tool reference load. POLARITY (higher is worse) IS PACK-AUTHOR JUDGEMENT - the manual states no polarity for any item.
mapping_provenance.STATUS.spindle_speed_actual: TNC 640 manual 1261174-24 s3.4 (p.81): 'Current spindle speed'. The adjacent 'Current deviation of the speed' is NOT mapped: the manual gives it no unit and no canonical field fits a signed speed deviation.
mapping_provenance.TOOL.NMAX: TNC 640 manual 1261174-24 s4 Tool data (p.154): 'Maximum speed [rpm]' for this tool. This is a LIMIT, not a reading; it maps onto spindle_speed_rpm because no canonical setpoint field exists, and the registry marks spindle_speed_rpm measurement_type `instantaneous`, so a consumer cannot tell this apart from an actual speed. Flagged, not hidden.
mapping_provenance.TOOL.OVRMAX: TNC 640 manual 1261174-24 s4 Tool data (p.154): 'Maximum feed rate override that occurred during machining. The control enters the value 100 (%) during the test run'. The sibling OVRMIN carries -1 during a test run and is deliberately NOT mapped: -1 is a sentinel, not an override, and feed_override_pct has no mechanism to mark it.
mapping_provenance.TOOL.SNOM: TNC 640 manual 1261174-24 s4 Tool data (p.154): 'Nominal spindle speed [rpm]'. Same setpoint-vs-reading caveat as TOOL.NMAX.
mapping_provenance.TOOL.T: TNC 640 manual 1261174-24 s4 Tool data (p.154): 'Tool number with tool index'. The index is dropped by this mapping - tool 5.2 and tool 5.3 both become 5.
mapping_provenance.identity.model: HEIDENHAIN StateMonitor product page (heidenhain.us/products/digital-shop-floor/statemonitor/) lists HEIDENHAIN DNC, OPC UA, umati, MTConnect, Modbus/TCP and FOCAS as its machine interfaces; the control model string is what distinguishes a TNC 640 from a TNC7 and pyLSV2 const.py ControlType enumerates {1 MILL_NEW, 2 MILL_OLD, 3 LATHE_NEW, 4 LATHE_OLD, 5 TNC7, 6 MILLPLUS, -1 UNKNOWN}.

not_mapped.OPC UA NC Server node names: HEIDENHAIN documents an OPC UA NC Server as a software option (TNC 640 manual s14, p.605) but no fetchable document lists its namespace, BrowseNames or object types. Omitted rather than guessed.
not_mapped.HEIDENHAIN DNC DCOM methods: Named in the TNC 640 specifications as a DCOM interface. No interface description was reachable. Omitted rather than guessed.
not_mapped.STATUS.ACTL: A position-display MODE selector, not a measurement. It changes what STATUS.X/Y/Z mean; no canonical field represents it.
not_mapped.STATUS.spindle_speed_deviation: 'Current deviation of the speed' (p.81). No unit stated by the vendor and no canonical field for a signed speed deviation.
not_mapped.STATUS.spindle_reference_load: 'Reference load of the spindle' (p.81). No canonical field for a per-tool reference baseline.
not_mapped.TOOL.OVRMIN: Carries the sentinel -1 during a test run (p.154). Mapping it onto feed_override_pct would store -1 as a real override.
not_mapped.MON / MON Detail tabs: Component monitoring, software option 155 (p.81). Contents not documented in the manual read.
not_mapped.NC error-message catalogue: The TNCguide 'NC Error Messages' branch at content.heidenhain.de is the authoritative alarm-code catalogue and was NOT read. alarm_code therefore carries a number with no documented meaning attached.
